observed.facings.png: Three facings of a bony, tan and rust-brown stilt-legged creature. South and north show a narrow, roof-shaped body with stacked crest plates on four knobbly legs. East shows a long horizontal thin body with a row of five backswept fins, a low beaked head and long jointed legs. All three stand about equally tall.
observed.south.png: Front view. A small beaked face with two amber eyes points at the camera, low under a ridged, peaked back with stacked pointed plates and small side spikes. Two long front legs with two knobbly joints each stand nearer the camera, and two shorter, darker hind legs stand behind them. Feet are small hoof-like pads. Clean cut-out.
observed.east.png: Side profile facing right. Long, thin, level body in rust over bone colour, five backswept sail-like fins along the back, beaked head held level with a small backswept crest. Four lower legs reach the ground. At the rear there are three upper limbs: a thick dark one hanging from the rump at far left and a pale one slanting back both run into the same left-most knee, while a third upper limb goes to its own knee. With the two front limbs that makes five upper limbs over four lower legs. A few extremely faint near-invisible specks lie in the empty area beside the legs.
observed.north.png: Rear view. Pointed rump tip and arched haunches, overlapping chevron plates receding up the back, no face or eyes. Two hind legs near the camera, two shorter front legs beyond. Clean cut-out.
observed.scale.png: East view beside the human at max zoom: the animal's belly is above the human's head height measured from its feet, and it is about 2.3 cells tall and 2.5 long. At 32 px per cell the long body with fins and four legs is still recognisable, but the thin tan legs are close in tone to the sand and fade.

observed.facings.png: Three facings of one purple and teal feathered bird at one scale. South is a broad, fluffy front view with feather tufts flaring to both sides of the head. East is a crow-like side profile with a long, two-tier crest swept backward. North is a rear view with a narrow head, and its crest is a single lobe drooping to the viewer's left. Size is close across the three.
observed.south.png: Front view of a stout bird: small pale hooked beak in the centre, two dark half-hidden eyes under a heavy brow, purple breast, teal sheen on the shoulders and on the crest. The crest parts in the middle and sweeps out like two horns to left and right, with smaller tufts beneath. Wings are folded and the two brown clawed feet are planted. The file carries a very faint near-zero-alpha haze around the body.
observed.east.png: Clean side profile facing right: dark grey curved beak, one small dark eye, large teal-violet crest swept back in two pointed tiers, folded wing with layered teal, green, blue and violet feathers, short tail pointing back and down, two bare dark legs.
observed.north.png: Rear view: rounded back of overlapping teal and purple feathers ending in a pointed central tail, two legs, narrow neck and head seen from behind with no eyes or beak. The crest is one asymmetric teal and purple swoosh curling to the viewer's left like a side-parted tuft of hair.
observed.scale.png: The bird beside a vanilla human. It is about 0.85 cell long and stands to roughly the human's chin. At 32 px per cell it is a small blue-purple bird with a visible crest and beak, about as long as the rat.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the back, tail and back of the head, with no eyes or beak.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three views are upright at the game camera, with legs below the body.

SAME_SIZE.seen: The card measures an 8% height spread. North's head and body are somewhat narrower than south's, but the bird reads as one size.

SIGNATURE.seen: Iridescent teal, green and violet sheen is obvious on the crest, shoulders and wings in every view.

ALIEN.seen: It resembles a crow or starling with a big crest, but the card says the description names its Earth body (a bird), and the required departure is present.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1. Iridescent plumage that reflects light and does not glow: present. The feathers shift teal, green, blue and violet as a surface sheen, with no emitted light or bloom.

STYLE.seen: Painted layered feathers, realistic scaled legs, and small dark eyes without gloss. Not cute or cel-shaded.

OURS.seen: The card gives its provenance as our own artpipe regeneration, and nothing in the picture suggests vanilla or donor art.

ALPHA.seen: Clean visible cut-out with no backdrop, ground or shadow. South carries only a nearly invisible haze (alpha below 8) around the body.
